Fixed the failing canary e2e test (image question selection) where the ready-state image card's radio used an `absolute inset-0 opacity-0 z-10` overlay that Playwright's hit test resolved to the parent `<label>` instead of the `<input>`, causing a 60s timeout. Changed the input to `sr-only` so the label's native click handling selects the radio. Also consolidated the duplicated provider-fetch logic in `ImageGenSection.jsx` into a shared `fetchProviders` callback. All API (375 files, 6206 tests) and frontend (290 files, 3910 tests) unit tests pass, lint is clean (0 errors).
